input.name: Take your time. I can be quiet while you work.

reaction: He repairs things in a workshop, like me. I said Take your time, I can be quiet. Nothing visible answered me, the sheet just closed. Did he hear it? Clock is stopped at 08:00, I have a Let time pass button now.

Ah, he did hear me, it showed after: He heard you and keeps working. Goals are clear now: fast, pay Osman 300 by day 15 with only 40 lira, see doctor, call Selin, afternoon shift. I am a voice in his head and he listens only a little. Money problem is the concrete one I want to work on.

One minute in: it is a quiet life sim where I am a voice in a grieving man. The plan menu (action, strength, reason) is the part I like. But time keeps moving while I read and I already missed one chance. Now it says see the doctor: chose something else, and I never saw that choice happen. Clock 09:33.

reaction: Good! He answered: After I finish this task (rest at home), I will do it. And my suggestion stays standing until 15:50 with a Withdraw button. That is what I wanted, an answer tied to my input. The 280 vs 300 number made the choice obvious. Now I wait and see if he keeps his word.

Hm. He said after resting until 13:15 he would take the shift. Now 14:19 and he is resting again until 14:45. So he did not keep it? Or he is still going to? I cannot tell. Hacer at the door says Osman is stingy and now he is angry. I will just keep listening.

He never went. 17:43 now, still 56 lira, rested all afternoon, my standing suggestion just disappeared without any message. He said I will do it and then did not. Nothing told me why. That feels like my input did not connect.

Why panel: rest at home, My grief makes me want to do this. OK, that is a reason I can accept for a widower. But the afternoon shift is not even in his list of options, so I still do not know what happened to my suggestion. Was it too late? Too weak (I only mentioned)?

I pressed Say it (urge, call Selin, for Selin) right as his meal ended at 19:45, and now he is smoking a cigarette out of habit and there is no sign my words were said at all. No standing suggestion, no answer. The plan screen with likely reply is the best thing here, but twice my input has vanished.

Correction: the Today log tells me everything. 14:31 He cannot take the afternoon shift just now (runs between noon prayer and an hour and a half before afternoon prayer), your suggestion waits... 15:50 Your suggestion fades. So my word was real, he just rested through the window. I wish that had been on the main screen, not hidden in Today. And the Selin urge did land: put you off, after the cigarette. Also he turned back from the mosque at noon because it brings back the funeral. That hit me.

reaction: He called her! I call Selin. I am doing this because you asked. First time since the funeral he called her himself. And he says I did not want to say that to an empty room. OK, that got me, my practical push turned into something real. This is the moment the game clicked for me.

input.name: Stay on the phone with Selin.

reaction: I am glad I said that aloud, love. Nice. Small odd thing: the panel still says calling Selin: he dreads it, while he is on the phone feeling glad. I expected that to change. Maybe it changes later.

Day 1 summary. He trusts me a little more because the Selin call went well. I like this end-of-day report, it is like a race debrief. One confusing line: call Selin: chose something else, right above he called today. I think it means without me he would not have, but I had to stop and think.

There it is: calling Selin now it feels hard, EASIER THAN AT THE START. So the dread did change, just overnight. Satisfying, like seeing a lap time drop. Day 2 plan: catch the noon window for the afternoon shift, and urge harder this time.

Pattern I notice: after Say it, the screen first shows nothing, then on the next tap my standing word and his answer appear. That one-step delay keeps making me think my input was lost. Doctor urge stands until 12:33, he will go after the workshop. Let us see.

reaction: He is going. See the doctor? I will do it. Because you asked. And right as he goes, the memory: I remember learning about Nuran illness at the clinic. Now I understand why he dreads it. I pushed him into the place where his wife got bad news. I feel a bit responsible, in a good way for a game.

Doctor: blood pressure high, rest, walk, stop smoking. And the visit cost 10 lira (72 to 62) and he left the workshop early. So health and rent pull against each other. That is a real trade-off, I like it. Clinic dread now also easier than at the start.
Requested layout check starts now (not spontaneous): resizing to 360x690 phone size. Just urged afternoon shift, it is your duty, at 13:41.

Back at 1280x800, layout check over. And: Take an afternoon shift? I will do it. Because you asked. This time I caught the window. Urge plus it is your duty worked where a plain mention yesterday faded. I learned the timing rule by failing once, which is how I like to learn.

Day 2 is going well: doctor done, shift taken. I now understand the rhythm, catch him at the moment he chooses, urge with a reason. Next target: stop the cigarette after the sunset meal, the doctor said so.
